parentExternalActions: An adult may open a source, support or privacy-policy link in the system browser. Those destinations have their own data practices. Do not attach child identifiers, progress or device IDs to their URLs.
mandatoryChecksBeforeSubmission: Inspect merged Android permissions, exported components and network security configuration.
Confirm no development server, remote code download, external font, third-party analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK is bundled.
Inspect all native and web dependencies and the production assets actually inside the APK/AAB.
Verify native speech and any bundled narration do not upload speech text or child audio. No microphone recording is part of the product.
Confirm the backup configuration matches local-only privacy claims and the published privacy policy.
Run the release offline and inspect any attempted network requests; distinguish adult-initiated system browser traffic from app traffic.
Complete the live Play Console Data safety and Bazaar privacy forms truthfully. These draft answers do not submit or certify either form.
